Venezuela Earthquake: Death Toll Rises, Aid Efforts Underway

Deadly earthquakes have struck Venezuela, with the death toll reported to be over 1,700 and thousands still missing. Rescue efforts are ongoing, with international aid being sent, including body bags from the UN. Some reports also highlight the disappearance of over 100 Venezuelans deported from the US shortly before the quakes, who may have been in a hotel that collapsed.
